messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH CPU/GPU queue growth — asia-east1 autoscaler failing to provision. Alert group: GPU‑capacity‑starvation.

oncall_sre_maya: Acknowledged. Spinning up context. Seeing repeated backoff from cloud API: 

infra_meera: logs: 
```
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z ERROR gcp: compute.instances.insert failed: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Insufficient regional GPU quota
requestId=abcd-1234
```

eng_ryan: Confirmed — scaleup attempts denied due to region GPU quota. Autoscaler is hitting 403/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and backing off. Queue length on inference workers up ~4200 requests, 60s p50 now 1.2s -> 6.8s for large requests.

prod_support_julian: Any visible customer impact? Support dashboard shows increased 503s from hosted API for high-TF workloads (esp. batch embedding jobs). Not widespread yet but trending.

oncall_sre_maya: Customer impact estimate: ~3% requests failing for heavy models, latency degrade for ~12% of traffic in apac region. Not global. Ticketing: support alerted.

pm_lina: Flagging high-value customer lane — we're notifying affected accounts. ETA for mitigation?

infra_meera: Short mitigations: 1) Evict noncritical warm pools in asia-east1 to free GPUs 2) Route conservative/low-priority traffic to asia-southeast1 3) Start manual provisioning in other regions 4) Open urgent quota increase with GCP.

eng_ryan: Implementing workaround: will temporarily enable model-level fallback to CPU-quantized variants for non-SLA traffic and enable strict batching caps to reduce burst GPU demand. Pushing canary in 2min.

oncall_sre_maya: I'm doing eviction now: `POST /internal/pools/evict?region=asia-east1&tag=warmpool&limit=8` — evicted 8 warm pools, reclaiming 16 GPUs. Will monitor queue.

infra_meera: Routing change: updating routing policy to prefer asia-southeast1 for non-PL1 customers. Patch: `route-policy: prefer: [asia-southeast1] when load>80% and region==asia-east1` — applied.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: routing-change v2 rolled (deploy id=v-2026-03-17-78).

prod_support_julian: Noting customer comms: email drafted to top affected accounts, PM Lina sign-off requested.

pm_lina: Approved. Send now. Include mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix.

gcp_support_bot: We have created case #GCP-99823 requesting regional GPU quota increase. Estimated review: 4-8 hours. You can set provisional CPUs/GPU via project-level quota change if you have billing-approved projects.

eng_ryan: Manual scale-up to other regions completed. We still have pending backlog — queue dropped from 4200 -> 900 after routing + evictions + fallbacks. Error rate down from 3% -> 0.7%. Latency improved.

oncall_sre_maya: Handoff: I'm going to stay for next 45m to watch for re-escalation, then hand to eng_ryan for follow-up. Adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu_quota_stall.md

infra_meera: Follow-up actions assigned: (1) permanent routing policy to avoid single-region saturation (owner: meera) (2) update autoscaler backoff window and quota-detection hook (owner: ryan) (3) add alert that ties RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED to automated customer-impact annotation (owner: maya).

eng_ryan: Quick note for postmortem: cause = sudden warmpool reclaim from internal experiments in apac + a recent quota policy change at org level. Need audit.

prod_support_julian: Customers notified. No escalations yet. Will reopen if GCP delays quota bump.

oncall_sre_maya: Closing pager for now — system stable at degraded level. Will switch to monitoring-only. Leaving thread for handoff. :thumbsup:

pm_lina: Thanks team. Let's schedule a follow-up 1hr retro and list action items for the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident state changed to MONITORING. Incident ID: INC-2026-1789994321.
